name: MiniMax-H3 (Hailuo 3.0) INT8 ConvRot
description: Official MiniMax components with Comfy-Org's published INT8 ConvRot FL2VA denoiser and Qwen3-VL conditioner, all in safetensors. Supports text, image, and first/last-frame generation; LightX2V 8-NFE v1.0 is the default and Base remains available at 50 NFE.
